modules.name: Susquehanna Oscillator
modules.description: Pitch-controlled oscillator with six ranges, sub-audio operation and clamp sync.

modules.name: Schuylkill VCA
modules.description: Linear or exponential amplifier with summed control inputs, differential signal input and inverted output.

modules.name: Lehigh Envelope
modules.description: Attack, decay, sustain and release envelope driven by an active-low gate.

modules.name: Allegheny Low-Pass
modules.description: Four-pole low-pass filter with three cutoff ranges and self-oscillating resonance.

modules.name: Monongahela High-Pass
modules.description: Four-pole high-pass filter with two cutoff ranges and summed cutoff modulation.

modules.name: Lackawanna Filters & Noise
modules.description: Independent low-pass and high-pass filters plus white and pink noise.

modules.name: Brandywine Filter Bank
modules.description: Twelve fixed band-pass bands with independent levels and low-pass and high-pass branches.

modules.name: Juniata Sequencer
modules.description: Three rows of eight stages with an internal clock, stage modes and optional third-row timing.

modules.name: Conestoga Interface
modules.description: Converts audio to gates and translates between positive gates and active-low triggers, with two timed banks.

modules.name: Tioga Sequential Switch
modules.description: Two- or three-stage signal switch with advance, direct stage selection and stage gates.

modules.name: Clarion Mixer
modules.description: Four-channel mixer with master gain, complementary outputs and two signal multiples.

modules.name: Kiski Attenuators
modules.description: Four cascaded attenuators, two signal multiples and bipolar reference voltages.

modules.name: Loyalsock Function Generator
modules.description: Two rise/fall generators and four attenuverters with sum, inversion and maximum outputs.

modules.name: Swatara Quantizer
modules.description: Scale and chord quantizer with three outputs, a shift register and a hold loop.
